items.summaryEn:
What does it mean to be an Original?
During the #MexicoGP, we asked the next generation of mechanics what being an Original means to them.
Because every Original starts somewhere, and never stops learning. @Valvoline
detailZh:
什么是原厂（Original）的含义？
在墨西哥大奖赛期间，我们询问了下一代机械师们，对他们来说原厂（Original）意味着什么。
因为每个原厂（Original）都是从某个地方开始的，并且永远不会停止学习。@Valvoline

What does it mean to be an Original?
